conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Hello, I'm Dr. Lee. I know you're not feeling well tonight. You're in the hospital now, and we're going to take care of you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: I know you can't speak, but we’re aware of your history — quadriplegia, tracheostomy, diabetes, and recent infections. You came in because you weren’t responding like usual and had low oxygen.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We checked your blood and found very high sodium and sugar. Your kidneys aren’t working as well right now. We’re giving you fluids and insulin to help.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your blood pressure dropped earlier, so we started medicine to support it. You’re on antibiotics too, in case an infection is making you sick.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We did a chest X-ray. It shows some lung changes, but it’s hard to tell if it’s infection or just fluid buildup. You’re breathing on your own with the trach mask, which is good.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ve reached your family. They know you’re a DNR/DNI and were considering comfort care. They want to talk more with us tomorrow.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Good morning. Your labs are improving — sodium is coming down, and your sugars are more stable. But your white blood count is still high, which suggests infection.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’re continuing the same antibiotics. Your kidney function hasn’t improved yet, but we’re watching closely.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family will be here soon. We’ll talk about your goals — whether to keep pushing with treatment or focus on comfort.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We just spoke with your family. After hearing everything, they’ve decided to shift to comfort measures only. That means we’ll stop aggressive treatments and focus on keeping you peaceful.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll keep you comfortable with medications like methadone for any discomfort and Ativan if you seem anxious. You’ll stay in this room, and your family can visit anytime.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: The palliative care team will help us manage your symptoms. You’re not alone in this.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Hi, it’s morning rounds. You’re still stable, but not responsive. Your breathing is slow but regular. We’re continuing comfort meds.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family was here last night. They held your hand and said they love you. They’re grateful for the care you’re getting.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re still with us, and we’re keeping you comfortable. Your breathing is a bit more shallow today, but you’re not in distress.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ve turned off the alarms on the monitors so it’s quiet. The room is dimmed. Your family knows changes may happen anytime.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your breathing is slower now. We’ve increased the methadone slightly to make sure you’re not struggling. You’re still peaceful.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Family is here. We’re all here with you. You’re not alone.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your breathing is very slow. We’ve placed extra pillows to make you comfortable. The chaplain stopped by to offer a blessing.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re still breathing, very quietly. Your family has been taking turns sitting with you. They said thank you for everything you’ve given them.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re still with us. We’ve kept the room warm and quiet. Your son stayed all night.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your breathing is irregular now. We’re here, and your family is on their way. You’re not in pain. You’re safe.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Family is gathered. We’re all here with you. You’ve been so strong.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re still breathing, very softly. We’ve turned off all non-essential equipment. Your daughter is holding your hand.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re still here. We’re keeping you comfortable. Your family is taking turns speaking to you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re very close now. We’re all here. You’re not alone.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’ve passed peacefully. Your family is here. Thank you for letting us care for you.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll call the time of death as 23:00. Your family wants to spend a little more time with you. That’s completely okay.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll notify the funeral home when the family is ready. They’ve declined an autopsy.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’ve been through so much. You’re at rest now.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll make sure your records reflect the dignity and care you received.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family asked us to thank the team. They’re so grateful for how gently you were treated.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll stay with you until they’re ready to say goodbye.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re not in pain. You’re not struggling. You’re at peace.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll continue to honor your journey with respect and care.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your family is still here. They’re saying their final words.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll give them all the time they need.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’ve been surrounded by love until the very end.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’ll make sure everything is handled with care.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Thank you for letting us be part of your story.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re at rest now. No more pain. No more struggle.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
